Hi Elena —

Great to meet you and Marcus on today's discovery. Quick recap and a proposed path forward so we can keep momentum:

Recap (2 bullets):
- Goal: Understand where Redwood would slot into your inference stack (main focus: lower-latency batch scoring and predictable tail latency for customer-facing features).
- Success criteria you mentioned: 1) < 150ms p95 for short prompts, 2) stable throughput > 200 QPS for batched jobs, 3) audit logs retained for 90 days.

Next step (30-min product tour + Q&A):
I propose a short product tour (30 minutes) to show the runtime, routing/fallback flows, and how we instrument cost/latency metrics. Can you pick one of these windows (all times PT):
- Option A: Tue Sep 2, 2027 — 09:00–09:30 PT
- Option B: Wed Sep 3, 2027 — 13:00–13:30 PT
- Option C: Thu Sep 4, 2027 — 11:30–12:00 PT

Please also loop in the person from Security/Infra who will evaluate audit logs & hosting constraints (we want to cover onboarding and Private/VPC controls in the session).

Attached: draft demo agenda (high level).

If none of those work, tell me two 30-minute bands next week and we'll adapt.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing this.

Sean Gallagher
